OUTPUT.description: Folder that export appends runs.jsonl to when no OTLP endpoint is set.

OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES.description: Resource attributes of the run as key=value pairs, set by the launcher, for example osf.run.id=…,osf.work_item.id=…,osf.factory.version=…,osf.stage=…. They override what runlog finds itself.

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.description: The service.name of the run. Default: the harness, for example claude-code.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.description: Base URL of an OTLP/HTTP receiver, for example http://collector:4318. When set, export sends the run to <url>/v1/traces instead of writing runs.jsonl.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT.description: Full URL of the OTLP/HTTP traces endpoint; takes precedence over OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS.description: Headers for the OTLP endpoint as key=value pairs, for example a token from a secret store. Never write the value into a file.
